mapped_record.title: 3BR Single Family in Cincinnati
mapped_record.description: Mt. Auburn: Close to Everything! We're now accepting applications for this newly remodeled home in Mt. Auburn, just minutes from Taft Elementary, Mt. Auburn Preparatory Academy, Christ Hospital (4 min. walk), God's Bible School & College (10 min. walk), and the University of Cincinnati (18 min. walk). In less than five minutes, you can also walk to major bus line stops. PROPERTY HIGHLIGHTS Convenient Mt. Auburn Location Spacious Rooms: 1700 Sq Ft House Fresh Paint & New Flooring Energy Efficient Windows & Lighting Family Friendly, Dead-End Street Backs to Greenspace Central Air Conditioning & Heat FIRST FLOOR FEATURES When you enter the foyer, you may quickly enter the downstairs living area or proceed upstairs to the bedroom level, both of which have been freshly painted and floored. On the first floor, you'll come to a spacious living room, newly floored with engineered hardwood, with high ceilings and two large windows that allow plenty of light into the room. Next, you'll enter a large dining room. After that, you'll proceed into a spacious kitchen equipped with a stove and refrigerator. If you turn the corner, you'll access the downstairs bathroom, which has a new shower, sink, toilet, tile floor and paint. SECOND FLOOR FEATURES At the top of the stairs leading to the second floor, you'll face the newly tiled and painted bedroom-level laundry room with washer and dryer hookups. If you turn right at the top of the stairs, you'll enter the middle bedroom, a shared-access bedroom which could also be used as a study, nursery, or family room. From there, you can proceed to the rear bedroom, a spacious bedroom with three windows, one of which looks directly out over greenspace. You can access the large front bedroom with two street-facing windows from the middle bedroom or the hallway. Just around the corner from the front bedroom and from the hallway is the full bath on the bedroom level, which has been newly tiled and painted. The house offers central air conditioning, central heat, an electric water heater and energy-efficient light fixtures throughout the residence. EXTERIOR FEATURES If you exit the rear door from the kitchen, you'll encounter the brand-new deck and two steps down leading to a storage shed and small backyard, including fire pit, which back up to green space. The full unfinished (mostly dry) basement and backyard shed are available for storage, though any items in the basement should be stored off the floor. The entire yard is fenced. Applicants may prequalify for the rental at no charge. If the prequalification is accepted, applicants submit a full application and pay an non-refundable application fee for a credit check and background check. To view the house after prequalifying, please contact us through RentRedi. The lessee is responsible for electric and gas utilities, plus the lessee must maintain renter's insurance. The lessor pays for water and sewer. NO pets are allowed at the property. NO smoking, vaping, or e-cigarettes of any kind on the property. Application criteria include the following: Minimum Credit Score: 600 Income 3x the Rent NO Prior Evictions/Eviction Notices NO Prior Lease Violations NO Violent Criminal History This property is using RentRedi for rent payments. With RentRedi, you can easily submit rent payments, boost your credit by reporting rent payments, sign up for affordable renters insurance, and more from the app!

With expansive rooms and sky high ceilings this traditional layout offers spacious living room with decorative mantle, full traditional dining room with chandelier, fully equipped renovated kitchen with stainless steel appliances and pantry, and first floor full bath with gorgeous tile walk in shower. The second floor features three extremely spacious bedrooms all complete with ceiling fans and neutral carpet flooring throughout, common hall walk in closet, and common hall full bath with newer vanity, fixtures, and shower/tub. From the kitchen or the dining room you can walk out to the three season room leading to your own backyard. Additional amenities include full unfinished basement, washer and dryer hookups, central heating and air, and off-street parking. Convenient location for any commute! Call for a private showing today!
